impact.alt: A farmer at the edge of a corn field checks a field map on a tablet
impact.decision: What to plant on each field for 2026–2029, and whether to add a cover crop.
before: Plants corn, then soybean, out of habit.
Plans the season from memory of when frost comes.
after: Has a four-year plan per field, ranked by what matters to them.
Plans for a frost-free season about 19 days longer than in 1981.
Puts winter rye on steep fields: erosion score 67% lower (a planning score).

metric.l: next-crop accuracy vs 81.4% from crop history alone

impact.alt: An agronomist reviews field data on a tablet with a grower
impact.decision: Which fields to scout first, and how much of each seed to stock.
before: Starts seed orders from last year's sheet.
after: Scouts the 114 squares where the forecast is unsure, and the 22.4 km² that lost greenness, first.
Stocks seed from a 30 m next-crop forecast for every field in the county.
Holds off on irrigation spending: four NASA water records show no trend.
